# Pre-task-context synthetic sources

These four fixtures were generated by the unchanged `9241a468d45b4e6c91ef1d1ba5dc420a2a0c26f5`
baseline binary against local scripted HTTP Providers. They contain a real read
Tool batch, a direct image Tool batch, a secondary Vision Tool batch and a long
Assistant answer for the legacy bounded-spine compaction regression. All
inputs, replies, targets, credentials used for local HTTP and projects are
synthetic; no user Sessions, test projects, accounts or model service were read.

The manifest binds the baseline executable and every preserved file by SHA256.
Files are deduplicated by exact content. Runtime locks and derived caches were
omitted; original Session/Research events, request component Blobs, artifact
bytes, project identity and source inputs are preserved without rewriting.
Historical paths and times describe only fixture generation, not current facts.

The tests copy a case into a new isolated project and verify every content hash.
Because project identity is tied to its canonical directory, the loader keeps
the newly initialized project configuration and relocates only each historical
audit's owning `binding.project_id`. Source EventIds, original IR, component
hashes, History, receipts and accepted-delivery references remain unchanged.
The tests then apply their explicit historical-version or missing-source controls.
New automatic selection cannot be used to manufacture a pre-feature Session
by deleting the facts on which the new selection depends.
